last.verdict: Revenue edged past forecasts, but a jump in planned spending worried investors.

reasons.label: Higher spending ahead
reasons.text: Next-quarter expenses guided to $1.01B-$1.16B, versus $975M this quarter.

reasons.label: Sales still shrinking
reasons.text: Revenue of $1.22B is down 35% from a year ago, with trading volume falling.

reasons.label: Profit flattered by gain
reasons.text: $719M net income came mostly from a $715M crypto holding gain; adjusted profit was $78M.

story: Revenue has stalled near $1.2B for two quarters after three straight misses; this time it narrowly beat forecasts. Quiet crypto trading keeps weighing on results, and the stock has now fallen after the last two reports.

history.verdict: Third straight revenue miss and weak July trading pushed investors to sell hard.

reasons.label: Revenue missed again
reasons.text: Revenue was $1.22B versus about $1.32B expected, down 19% from a year ago.

reasons.label: Weak July trading
reasons.text: Trading revenue was only about $130M through July 26, after $599M in the second quarter.

reasons.label: Services revenue fell short
reasons.text: Subscription and services revenue missed Coinbase's own guide. Next quarter is guided at $500M-$580M.
